name: kg_delete_edge
description: Delete one relationship (edge) from the knowledge graph. Does NOT delete the endpoint nodes. Audited: requires a non-empty `reason`, refuses user-locked edges and edges whose endpoint nodes are user-locked, and snapshots the edge into kg_revision_log so the deletion can be reverted. Pass `dry_run: true` to preview without committing.

inputs.name: edge_id
inputs.description: UUID of the edge to delete.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why this deletion is correct. Goes into kg_revision_log.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Preview the deletion; do not commit. Default false.

outputs.description: {ok, revision_log_id, deleted} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before, after} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_delete_edge:
- edge_id (required): UUID of the edge to delete
- reason (required): why this deletion is correct
- dry_run (optional): preview only
- finding_id (optional): source finding row id

Example:
{
    "edge_id": "edge-abc-123-def-456",
    "reason": "Duplicate of edge xyz — same fact asserted twice"
}
